headline: GMO Internet Shares Fall Sharply in Tokyo Trading
summary: Shares of Japanese web infrastructure provider GMO Internet experienced a steep decline during trading in Tokyo.
why: GMO Internet Group is a publicly traded Japanese provider of domain registration, hosting, and digital financial services.

impacts.name: GMO Internet Group
impacts.why: Company shares plummeted during the trading session in Tokyo.

why_moved: GMO Internet stock declined sharply in Tokyo market trading.
